meta.title: Reunion · light continue and persona
meta.description: Not a sidebar session importer—use DeepSeek Chat Import (or similar) for full chat bubbles. Reunion does two jobs: (1) thread = low-context continuation (~3.5k chars: facts, voice anchors, recent turns); (2) merge/separate = portable persona (SOUL+MEMORY). Defaults to thread for share links and when exactly one conversation is selected. Local exports stay offline; share URLs fetch the public snapshot. No telemetry. Continue with thread+load; persona needs digest/compose/commit. Uninstall never deletes companions/.
